permits.name: Temporary Event
permits.description: Synthetic pre-check for a short-duration public event.

questions.label: Event duration
questions.question: How many days will the event run?
questions.help_text: Include setup days only if the activity is open to attendees.

questions.label: Expected attendance
questions.question: What is the maximum expected attendance?

questions.label: Emergency plan
questions.question: Do you have an emergency plan for the event?

questions.label: Venue permission
questions.question: Do you already have permission from the venue owner?

questions.label: Amplified sound
questions.question: Will the event use amplified sound?

questions.label: Amplified sound end time
questions.question: At what hour will amplified sound end?
questions.help_text: Use a 24-hour whole number, for example 21 for 9 PM.

questions.label: Food service
questions.question: Will food be served or sold at the event?

questions.label: Food-safety plan
questions.question: Do you have a food-safety plan?

permits.name: Temporary Food Stall
permits.description: Synthetic pre-check for a temporary food stall at an event.

questions.label: Operating duration
questions.question: How many days will the stall operate?

questions.label: Food-handler training
questions.question: Have all food handlers completed food-safety training?

questions.label: Handwashing facility
questions.question: Will a handwashing facility be available?

questions.label: Registration proof
questions.question: Do you have the demo registration proof?

questions.label: Open-flame use
questions.question: Will the stall use any other open flame?

questions.label: Fire extinguisher
questions.question: Will a suitable fire extinguisher be available?

questions.label: Perishable food
questions.question: Will the stall serve perishable food?

questions.label: Cold storage
questions.question: Will suitable cold storage be available?
